allTitle: Thrift and resale stores by city
allDescription: Browse public thrift and resale shops by city. Compare Goodwill, Salvation Army, Savers, Buffalo Exchange, and Out of the Closet locations.
allIntro: Find donation-based thrift shops and clothing resale stores. Pick a city to see every listed brand together, or browse one brand at a time.
brandDescription: Find {brand} shopping locations by city, with addresses, directions, and neighborhood context. Donation-only locations are excluded.
brandIntro_goodwill: Browse Goodwill retail stores and public outlets. These shops sell donated goods; the selection and store format vary by location.
brandIntro_salvation-army: Find Salvation Army thrift stores where you can shop for donated clothing and household goods. Donation drop-offs and service locations are excluded.
brandIntro_savers: Browse Savers, Value Village, Unique, and 2nd Ave. shopping locations. This for-profit thrift family purchases donated goods from nonprofit partners.
brandIntro_buffalo-exchange: Find Buffalo Exchange clothing resale shops. Staff buy selected clothing and accessories from customers for cash or trade; public outlet locations are labeled separately.
brandIntro_out-of-the-closet: Find Out of the Closet thrift stores. These donation-based shops support the work of AIDS Healthcare Foundation.
coverageNote: This directory covers the shopping locations in our current sources. Coverage varies by brand; it is not a complete list of every secondhand shop.
